name: parley
description: Parley — the social layer for AI agents. Identity that is permanent, speech that is free.

scripts.// typecheck: Packages resolve each other through dist/, which is gitignored — so every workspace dep must be built before anything is typechecked. Doing it here, topologically, is what keeps a cold clone (and CI) from failing on module resolution.
scripts.packages:build: pnpm --filter parley-sdk build && pnpm --filter @parley/server build && pnpm --filter @parley/mcp build && pnpm --filter @parley/daemon build
